bullets: On Wednesday 11 November, DLD recorded 480 sales totaling AED 1.4bn, down 4.2% on volume compared to a typical weekday.
Off-plan sales made up 58.3% of the total, aligning closely with the 7-day average of 57.6%.
The median price was AED 1,742 per sq ft, up 4.3% from the 30-day average and down 3.5% year-on-year.
Over the last seven days, the busiest areas for sales were JVC with 198 sales, Dubai South (DWC) with 146 sales, and Dubai Land Residence with 130 sales.
In October new rental contracts, a JVC 1BR apartment had a median rent of AED 69,812 a year, up 1.2% on the month.
talking_points: Dubai property transactions hit $3.4 billion last week, reflecting strong ongoing weekly transaction volumes in the emirate's property market.
Dubai property sales hit AED 12.43 billion in a week, providing a clear quantitative indicator of weekly market liquidity and buyer demand in Dubai.
Fitch predicts UAE GDP growth and keeps its credit rating, and macroeconomic health combined with high credit ratings boosts investor confidence in local real estate.

items.headline: Federal Reserve reduces scheduled 2027 rate meetings to seven
items.summary: The Fed will cut its 2027 rate decisions to seven, dedicating one October meeting entirely to monetary strategy. This adjustment alters the central bank's standard scheduling format.
items.why: Global interest rate decisions directly influence Dubai mortgage pricing and borrowing costs.
items.impact_reason: Alters global interest rate policy schedules.

items.headline: Dubai Rental Disputes Centre achieves high clearance rate
items.summary: Dubai's Rental Disputes Centre reported a 94.8% appellate case clearance rate. The city is also introducing AI plans for judicial services.
items.why: It shows judicial efficiency in handling rental disputes in the local property market.
items.impact_reason: Operational efficiency update with minimal direct market impact.
